run_compute_score: run the CUAD evaluation script with a dataset file and a prediction file via CLI
compute_precision_recall: compute precision and recall for predictions against ground truth answers in the CUAD dataset
get_aupr: get the area under the precision-recall curve from sorted precision and recall lists
get_prec_at_recall: get precision at a specified recall threshold from sorted precision and recall lists
exact_match_score: compute exact match score between a prediction and ground truth answer after normalization
